Each hour: time, direction and speed (knots, g = gust), odds of 12kt or more, regime, waves, tide height in ft with r rising or f falling. OUTFLOW NOT RIDDEN = Squamish outflow, never recommend. OFF DIR = direction does not work at that spot.
Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Mon, Nov 23 7:59am to 5:58pm; Tue, Nov 24 8am to 5:57pm; Wed, Nov 25 8:02am to 5:57pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Mon, Nov 23 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Porteau may be the call again. Pam Rocks dipped to N 15 at 5am but is back to N 22 at 7am and climbing, and our forecast holds 23 to 24 all day. The last two outflows held longer than the forecast.

Porteau from about 11am to 3pm. Low tide 11.5ft at 11am, then flooding to 15.2ft by 4pm, so the swell may soften late.  Check before driving: Pam Rocks N 22+ at 10am. Check Fury Creek as well as the wind direction has been hitting there a lot stronger than Porteau in the last couple of days.

The SE is not super strong today but it may reach Boundary, Ferry Terminal, Erwin and Jericho depending on how much west the system passes.
